environment: gcc:13 Linux amd64 Docker on Apple Silicon; network none; read-only project and analysis mounts; temporary compilation; -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror; EEC_CHECK_CALLBACK_WORK enabled
units: Raw simulator units: batch edp=energy*final_clock; response_edp=energy*mean_turnaround
baseline: Current working tree: 4 small + 3 big; P3 with final-interval P4; C4 timeout 10000; nonpreemptive SJF
verification: 352 runs passed independent completion, context ownership, callback work preservation and active-energy lower-bound checks. Postprocessing checks per-core counts/work, identical paired workloads, and wait+service=turnaround. Ten current baseline workloads exactly reproduce archived c4-timeout-results.json counters.
active_energy_method: Only P3/tail, timer-grid, no-migration runs: sum over first-dispatched jobs W, using actual assigned core. K=400,A=5600,B=3600 for big cores; K=240,A=2800,B=1800 for small cores; q=W//K,r=W%K; E=q*A+(0 if r=0 else B if r<=K/2 else A). Nonstartup idle=total-active-startup. Faster states and no-tail omit this estimate.

reproduction_sources.run.sh:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
renames='-DCreateProcess=PolicyCreateProcess -DExitProcess=PolicyExitProcess -DTimerInterrupt=PolicyTimerInterrupt -DCStateTransitionComplete=PolicyCStateTransitionComplete -DSimulationComplete=PolicySimulationComplete'
g++ -std=gnu++17 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -DEEC_CHECK_CALLBACK_WORK -I/work/src -c /analysis/driver.cpp -o /tmp/driver.o
g++ -std=gnu++17 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -I/work/src -c /work/src/ready_queue.cpp -o /tmp/sjf.o
g++ -std=gnu++17 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -I/work/src -c /analysis/fifo.cpp -o /tmp/fifo.o
run_policy() {
    name=$1 big=$2 state=$3 timeout=$4 tail=$5 queue=$6
    g++ -std=gnu++17 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -I/work/src $renames -DEEC_BIG_CORES="$big" -DEEC_SMALL_CORES=4 -DEEC_PSTATE="$state" -DEEC_IDLE_TIMEOUT="$timeout" -DEEC_TAIL_DVFS="$tail" -c /work/src/scheduler.cpp -o /tmp/policy.o
    g++ /tmp/driver.o /tmp/policy.o "/tmp/$queue.o" -L/work/src -lsim -Wl,-rpath,/work/src -Wl,--wrap=_Z11LoadContextjj -Wl,--wrap=_Z11SaveContextjj -o /tmp/benchmark
    printf 'POLICY %s\n' "$name"
    for scenario in seed:0 seed:1 seed:2 seed:3 seed:4 seed:5 single burst gaps mixed boundary late short-gaps long-gaps changing-gaps timeout-demand; do
        /tmp/benchmark "$scenario"
    done
}
run_policy current 3 P3 10000 1 sjf
run_policy big4 4 P3 10000 1 sjf
run_policy big2 2 P3 10000 1 sjf
run_policy big0 0 P3 10000 1 sjf
for timeout in 1 1000 100000 500000 2000000 1000000000000; do
    run_policy "timeout-$timeout" 3 P3 "$timeout" 1 sjf
done
for timeout in 100000 500000 2000000; do
    run_policy "big4-timeout-$timeout" 4 P3 "$timeout" 1 sjf
done
for state in P0 P1 P2 P4; do
    run_policy "state-$state" 3 "$state" 10000 0 sjf
done
run_policy fifo 3 P3 10000 1 fifo
run_policy no-tail 3 P3 10000 0 sjf

docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 --network none --read-only --mount type=bind,source="$PWD",target=/work,readonly --mount type=bind,source=/tmp/eec-current-bottlenecks,target=/analysis,readonly --tmpfs /tmp:rw,exec,size=128m gcc:13 sh /analysis/run.sh
